about: Saint-Eustache is a Laurentides city on the rivière des Mille Îles, on Montréal’s North Shore west of Laval. It is best known as a Patriote town of 1837, when fighting centred on the parish church, and it still has a stone village core beside the river. Moulin Légaré continues to mill grain by water power. About 45,000 people live in Saint-Eustache.
